title: Spec frontmatter should include signal_id and initiating run_id
description: Specs are authored in response to signals from specific runs but carry no frontmatter link back to the signal_id or run_id that triggered them. Without this, tracing a spec back to its originating signal requires searching run files and signal catalogues manually, which breaks in the autonomous pipeline where correlation must be machine-readable.
proposed_resolution: Update the spec skill to write signal_id and initiating_run_id into spec frontmatter when invoked via signal_fix. Update the spec schema (spec-schema.yaml and spec-schema-validation.json) to declare these as optional fields. The spec README index should display the signal_id where present.
